old.title: Biofield Tuning Sessions & Tuning Fork Sound Healing Explained (PLUS)
old.description:
What is your aura, and can a tuning fork actually read it? In this solo episode, Chance Garton explains how tuning forks find and release stuck energy in the electromagnetic field around the body, drawing on more than 600 tuning sessions of his own and the work of Biofield Tuning founder Eileen Day McKusick, author of Tuning the Human Biofield and Electric Body, Electric Health.

From the electricity running through your nerves to the faint light your cells give off, Chance lays out why sound can shift the way energy flows through you, why your mind and memory may live in your field rather than your brain, and how your biofield stores your life story like the rings of a tree, with birth at the outer edge and the present moment closest to the skin. Real session stories show how a fork held in the right spot can surface a long forgotten memory, reveal a repeating life pattern, or release tension the body has carried for years.
